chunks: And it will be said to them: 'Where are those you worshipped?'
ai.seo_question: What will be asked to polytheists on the Day of Judgment regarding their idols?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate futility of idolatry, emphasizing that false gods will be silent witnesses to their owners' ruin on the Day of Resurrection. It serves as a profound reminder of Tawhid (monotheism) by contrasting the transient nature of created idols with the eternal power of Allah, who alone will hold the scales of justice.
